title: Multi-Site health history and trend runtime guard
red: SiteHealthReadRuntimeGuardContractTests initially failed because history and trend endpoints did not guard persisted Site reads against an inactive runtime snapshot.
focusedTests: 9/9 focused read, fallback, topology, and trend tests passed with 0 failures and 0 skips
implementation: History and trend now call SiteRuntimeState.IsPendingRestart immediately after resolving the Site and return an explicit pending-restart envelope before process-memory or PostgreSQL history reads and before Alert calculation.
boundary: This module does not activate, mutate, or delete Site configuration. Active-site database fallback and existing role, CSRF, timeout, acknowledgement write, external CodeQL, penetration, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode, and production certification boundaries remain unchanged.
